$comment: Static, public network parameters. Source of truth: https://developers.stellar.org/docs/networks — keep web/lib/stellar/networks.ts and contracts/network.toml in sync with this file. Per-network contract ids (USDC SAC, Reflector feed, deployed Kaido contracts, admin multisig, Launchtube) are NOT stored here; they are resolved at deploy time and written by the deploy scripts. Testnet resets ~2-4x/year (next: 2026-06-17, 2026-12-16) — nothing off-chain may treat a testnet contract id as permanent.

mainnet.$comment: Mainnet has no canonical public RPC/Horizon — use a third-party provider (https://developers.stellar.org/docs/data/apis/rpc/providers) and set RPC_URL/HORIZON_URL via .env. Mainnet does not reset.
